# Effect types

Inventions, custom possibilities and activities are made only of these effects. The text model that
invents ideas is given the same list. Code validates every effect and clamps its numbers to the ranges below
(see `public/src/effects/registry.js`).

"who" is `self`, `target` or `everyone_near`.

| Type               | Example                                                                                                                                  | Notes                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `item`             | `{"type":"item","who":"self","item":"carving","amount":1}`                                                                               | gain (+) or use up (-) items, -5..5. Any simple noun works as a new item.                                                  |
| `transfer`         | `{"type":"transfer","from":"self","to":"target","item":"coins","amount":3}`                                                              | hand items between self and target, 1..10                                                                                  |
| `give_place`       | `{"type":"give_place","place":"here","to":"target"}`                                                                                     | hand over something the doer owns (a house, a shop)                                                                        |
| `need`             | `{"type":"need","who":"self","need":"hunger","amount":-30}`                                                                              | hunger/thirst/energy change, -50..50 (negative hunger = less hungry)                                                       |
| `health`           | `{"type":"health","who":"target","amount":15}`                                                                                           | -30..30                                                                                                                    |
| `mood`             | `{"type":"mood","who":"everyone_near","amount":1}`                                                                                       | -2..2                                                                                                                      |
| `skill`            | `{"type":"skill","who":"self","skill":"crafting","amount":3}`                                                                            | 1..5; skills: farming, woodcutting, fishing, herbalism, crafting, cooking, music, fighting, scholarship, trade, leadership |
| `status`           | `{"type":"status","who":"self","name":"tipsy","hours":4,"per_hour":{"mood":0.3,"energy":-3}}`                                            | a temporary condition; per_hour keys hunger/thirst/energy (-10..10), health (-5..5), mood (-0.5..0.5)                      |
| `sick`, `cure`     | `{"type":"sick","who":"target"} / {"type":"cure","who":"target"}`                                                                        |                                                                                                                            |
| `opinion`          | `{"type":"opinion","who":"target","aff":8,"trust":0,"rom":0,"why":"gave me a gift"}`                                                     | how "who" feels about the doer, each -25..25                                                                               |
| `rumor`            | `{"type":"rumor","about":"target","claim":"Tobias waters down the ale","positive":false}`                                                | spread a claim about someone ("target" or a villager's name); listeners' opinion of them shifts                            |
| `sway`             | `{"type":"sway","who":"target","about":"Hugo","aff":-10,"trust":0}`                                                                      | change how the target feels about a third person (matchmaking, turning people against someone), -15..15                    |
| `learn_secret`     | `{"type":"learn_secret","from":"target"}`                                                                                                | the doer learns the target's secret (spying, a heart-to-heart)                                                             |
| `summon`           | `{"type":"summon","who":"target","place":"Village Hall"}`                                                                                | ask someone to come to a place (they decide whether to go)                                                                 |
| `role`             | `{"type":"role","who":"self","role":"midwife"}`                                                                                          | take up a new trade or title                                                                                               |
| `build`            | `{"type":"build","name":"Pigeon Loft","desc":"...","bed":false,"produce":{"in":{"food":1},"out":{"message":1},"text":"trains pigeons"}}` | creates a place here ("produce" optional: makes it a business)                                                             |
| `damage`, `repair` | `{"type":"damage","place":"here","amount":30} / {"type":"repair","place":"here","amount":30}`                                            | a building's condition, 5..60 ("here" = where it's done)                                                                   |
| `resource`         | `{"type":"resource","place":"here","amount":8}`                                                                                          | grow (+) or deplete (-) a place's natural resource, -15..15                                                                |
| `weather`          | `{"type":"weather","kind":"rain"}`                                                                                                       | clear\|cloudy\|rain\|storm\|fog (rare, for rituals)                                                                        |
| `problem`          | `{"type":"problem","title":"...","desc":"...","skill":"scholarship"}`                                                                    | creates a village problem people can work on                                                                               |
| `progress`         | `{"type":"progress","problem":"<existing problem title>","amount":10}`                                                                   | 1..30                                                                                                                      |
| `news`             | `{"type":"news","text":"Mira is holding a dance tonight","scope":"all"}`                                                                 | spreads as gossip; scope near\|all                                                                                         |
| `gathering`        | `{"type":"gathering","title":"Bonfire night","place":"Village Square","in_hours":2,"duration_hours":3}`                                  | invites the village to an event                                                                                            |
| `law`              | `{"type":"law","text":"No fishing on holy days."}`                                                                                       | only for laws decreed by the leader                                                                                        |
| `later`            | `{"type":"later","hours":8,"effects":[...]}`                                                                                             | effects that happen later (fermenting, healing, a plan paying off), 1..48h                                                 |

An invention can also have a skill check: `"check":{"skill":"crafting","difficulty":"easy|normal|hard"}`
with `"fail_effects":[...]` for when it fails.
